A:TOKEN_CRITERIA: For a specified physical subhistory P over interval I, admission to P_actual requires actual nonempty event/state support, fidelity to induced physical relations, traceable causal continuity, representation of materially relevant boundary influences, traceable lineage, and invariance under invertible descriptions. These are domain requirements; no effective universally sufficient physical admission algorithm is supplied.
A:ACTUAL_TOKEN: P_actual denotes the declared domain of actual valid physical process occurrences satisfying TOKEN_CRITERIA at their specified intervals and boundaries. Quantification over P_actual is not quantification over all mathematical state tables or all coarse features.
A:P3: For every P,Q and interval I in the declared physical comparison, Persist(P,I) AND Embed(P,Q,I) implies that P remains in P_actual throughout I. Persist requires continuing constitutive support/dynamics/boundary and lineage; embedding alone neither establishes persistence nor establishes cessation.
A:P6: Numerical token equality P=Q, complete-type equivalence D(P) isomorphic to D(Q), and directed causal-lineage relation P leads_to Q are distinct relations. Type equivalence need not imply token equality; lineage may branch or merge and is not an equivalence relation or a subject-count function.
A:D_ONTIC: For each admitted occurrence P at the declared time/interval and comparison signature K, D_ontic_K(P) is the K-structure containing every distinction constitutive of that token. It need not contain every microfact in the substrate; a finite measured model is not presumed complete.
A:K: Fix one many-sorted comparison signature K, including distinguished constitutive carrier, current-state pointing, time orientation, state/update/port/readout and constituent relations wherever claimed. Isomorphisms are sortwise bijections preserving and reflecting all K relations and commuting with its operations; only declared port symmetries are allowed. Physical and experiential structures use this SAME K.
A:QSPACE: For the fixed admissible class of K-structures, S_K is its quotient by K-isomorphism and q_K(X) is X's class. Use a set-sized comparison universe, or state a universe convention, before using S_K as a set. P and Q can be distinct tokens with q_K(D(P))=q_K(D(Q)).
A:GEOMETRY: Fix before the target comparison a topology tau_K or a nonnegative symmetric triangle-satisfying pseudometric delta_K on S_K. No separation of distinct points by delta is required. Use the identical geometry for physical and experiential types; C1 supplies no unique or empirically calibrated choice.
A:VIEW: For a fixed view v=(time,horizon,grain,intervention family,boundary representation,...), D_v(P)=Pi_v(D_ontic(P)). Pi_v may be noninjective; different views need not be comparable. If maps between views are asserted, their domains and exact/approximate commutation must be separately supplied.
A:ESTIMATE: An estimator Dhat_v(P|evidence,model_class) or identified set I_v={D compatible with the declared evidence/error model} concerns the fixed view D_v. Estimator equality is not view equality; view equality is not complete-type equality.
A:SUBJECT_FIREWALL: The basal theory quantifies over P_actual without a required global exclusive subject selector. Using 'subject' for a process requires naming that process; using it for a human-like owner/conceptual self requires separate organization/semantic predicates. Neither use identifies every overlap or nested process with one canonical owner.
A:C1: For every P in P_actual in the fixed signature K, there exist an experiential K-structure Phi_K(P) and a sort-preserving isomorphism h_P:D_ontic_K(P)->Phi_K(P). This is the stipulated tokenwise structural-experiential identity axiom, including its experiential interpretation and existential commitment; it is not an empirically derived bijection or a scalar measure.
A:SELF_WITNESS: There exists P0 in the same admitted actual domain such that NOT Self_I(P0), where Self_I is the fixed predicate for human-like conceptual selfhood. Actuality and correct semantic classification of P0 are supplied independently.
A:NONUNIV_WITNESS: For a fixed proposed gate G:P_actual-> {0,1} and the exact claimed comparison subdomain D subset P_actual, there exists P0 in D with G(P0)=0. A witness outside D does not discharge this premise.
A:COMPLETE_EQ: The two specified actual occurrences P,Q, with their compared present times and identical K, satisfy D_ontic_K(P) isomorphic to D_ontic_K(Q). Every currently constitutive consequence of any other claimed difference is included or shown screened.
A:PROBE_ONLY: The compared change is only an analyst's external probe/description choice; it does not alter the current complete organization of the SAME target occurrences. A physically disturbing probe does not satisfy this premise merely because it is called a measurement.
A:FUTURE_ONLY: P and Q may have different later histories, but the compared present complete organizations and presently constitutive causal dispositions are fixed equal. Changing a current disposition is not a future-only difference.
A:HISTORY_DIFF: The compared P,Q have different histories/lineages, while all their current constitutive consequences are screened in the complete present comparison. This does not identify the numerical occurrences or assert that history generally lacks current effects.
A:LABEL_ONLY: Only an external evaluator's label/reward annotation changes. Its physical encoding or causal use is absent from, or unchanged in, the complete organization of the target tokens. Changing an installed reward circuit fails this label-only premise.
A:PRODUCT_DEF: Fix constituent slots i=1,...,n and a common independent-product construction in K: pointed product carriers with specified component-local operations, boundary conventions and incidence. The SAME construction is used for D_i and Phi_i and transports constituent isomorphisms. Arbitrary repartitioning or port mixing is excluded.
A:ACTUAL_WHOLE_PARTS: The specified whole W and each specified constituent P_i are actual admitted tokens over the declared comparison intervals; all D and Phi structures and the chosen independent product use the compatible K and fixed constituent slots.
A:PHYS_NONPRODUCT: For that W, constituent list and declared independent product, D_ontic(W) is NOT isomorphic to product_i D_ontic(P_i). This is a supplied complete structural fact, not a consequence of drawing a coupling arrow alone.
A:MACRO_EQ: The independently grounded actual macro tokens Pm,Qm have isomorphic COMPLETE macro organization in their common signature; the lower differences under discussion are nonconstitutive for these macro tokens.
A:MICRO_NONISO: The specified actual lower-scale tokens Pl,Ql have NONisomorphic complete organizations in their own common signature. They are not substituted for the macro tokens of MACRO_EQ.
A:SYM_PREM: Fix a structure W, automorphism group Gamma=Aut(W), and Gamma-invariant candidate family B(W). Gamma acts on candidates and on candidate subsets; no unrepresented distinguishing label is available.
A:EQUIV_SELECTOR: S is a deterministic set-valued selector on the declared structure domain with S(gW)=gS(W) for every admitted isomorphism g; at an automorphism of W its output is invariant. A singleton selector is a special case; a random seed is extra structure.
A:OVERLAP_NONEMPTY_EXCL: At W the ENTIRE allowed candidate family is a single Gamma orbit containing two distinct overlapping candidates. Required S(W) is a nonempty subset of that orbit whose distinct members are pairwise disjoint.
A:ALL_ANC_ACTUAL: Fix a comparison index set Lambda for the stipulated all-ancestors/organizational-formation family and independently admit each P_lambda as an actual token. Actual coexistence is a thought-experiment supposition, not historical observation or a continuity premise.
A:EPS_CHAIN: For a fixed epsilon>0 and the predeclared delta_K, the supplied actual-token chain (P_i) satisfies delta_K(qD(P_i),qD(P_(i+1)))<epsilon for each adjacent pair. The same chain, interval convention and K occur on the experiential side.
A:PHYS_CONT_PATH: For a declared topological parameter space Lambda and comparable actual P_lambda, d(lambda)=q_K(D(P_lambda)) is continuous into the predeclared (S_K,tau_K). Continuity of biological/developmental paths is an independent modeling premise.
A:CONNECTED_LAMBDA: Lambda is a nonempty connected topological parameter space in the E3 comparison. Connectedness is required of that space, not merely a finite list of similar examples.
A:CONT_BINARY_E: The existence predicate E:Lambda->{0,1} is continuous when {0,1} has the discrete topology. This is a separate premise; continuity of physical organization or of a nonnegative graded magnitude does not establish it.
A:HUMAN_ENDPOINT: There exists lambda_h in the SAME Lambda with E(lambda_h)=1. The experiential classification is supplied; a named endpoint alone is not a mathematical proof of that value.
A:PHYS_TRANSFORM_NONISO: For the fixed actual before/after comparison P,Q and complete signature K, D(P) and D(Q) are nonisomorphic. Numerical parameter change or an observer's new coordinate system alone does not establish this premise.
A:TOY_MATH: Over F2, for each alpha,beta in {0,1}, x=(s,a,b), u in {0,1}, T_u(x)=(s XOR u,s XOR alpha*b,s XOR beta*a), y=s. Fix one clock tick, all 27 coordinate clamps before update, buffered no-feedback s port, pointed state and named constituent slots. Compare mechanisms at fixed alpha,beta; for pair retention hold the same s boundary trajectory and vary all four initial (a,b), with no subsequent pair resets.
A:ACTUAL_COMPLETE_TOY: The particular finite structures compared by TOY_MATH faithfully describe the complete constitutive organizations of independently admitted actual tokens at the claimed whole or sub-process level. An admissible complete isomorphism must preserve the represented distinctions. Completeness for the whole does not automatically prove completeness for a differently bounded sub-process.
A:PHEN_TARGET: Psi_v:P_actual->Y_v is the fixed finite psychophysical/phenomenal target, including its equivalence relation, measurement procedure and interpretation. It is not identified with complete Phi; reports, ratings and no-report proxies require justified target interpretation.
A:BRIDGE_FWD: For all compared P,Q in the fixed domain, D_v(P) isomorphic to D_v(Q) implies Psi_v(P) equivalent to Psi_v(Q). Equivalently the target class factors through the view class on the realized image. This is independently assumed for that v and target.
A:BRIDGE_REV: For all compared P,Q in the fixed domain, Psi_v(P) equivalent to Psi_v(Q) implies D_v(P) isomorphic to D_v(Q). This reflection condition is independent of BRIDGE_FWD and is generally destroyed by lossy target projection.
A:MEAS: Specify physical/target distances or equivalences, sampling law, error and tolerance definitions, and justified rules for declaring equality/difference. Exact examples set errors to zero. Statistical nonrejection alone does not establish equivalence; approximate implications require their own numerical modulus and error bounds.
A:PTVSP: Before target unblinding fix actual-token hypotheses, view and intervention domains, held-out physical targets, sufficiency/stability/reproducibility assessment, model-selection rule, and final token/view/bridge version. A post-result change creates a NEW hypothesis; it does not rescue the previously failed frozen implication.
A:BAC_TFR: Use B:BAC for the fixed admissible bridge and B:TFR for target-fidelity/residual requirements; both predicates must hold jointly on the SAME source theory subclaim and comparison domain. Naming these predicates does not establish them.
A:ACTUAL_PERSISTING_PARTS: Each identified constituent P_i actually continues its constitutive support/dynamics and traceable lineage over I while embedded in W; Persist(P_i,I) and Embed(P_i,W,I) hold for each i. A merely remembered or simulated constituent does not discharge this physical premise.
A:FINITE_COARSE_SETUP: Fix finite nonempty S, surjection p:S->Z=p(S), and deterministic total operations F_a:S->S for each named operation a. Time, boundary/input labels and operation availability are fixed. A quotient means maps Fbar_a:Z->Z satisfying p F_a=Fbar_a p for EVERY state and named operation.
A:FORWARD_MISMATCH: There exist compared P,Q in the frozen domain whose true view classes agree while target classes differ, with both claims established exactly or through the preregistered sound error/tolerance model. This contradicts the frozen forward implication.
A:REVERSE_MISMATCH: There exist compared P,Q in the frozen domain whose view classes differ while target classes agree, established exactly or with the stipulated sound error/tolerance model. This contradicts the frozen reflection implication.
A:FROZEN_SCOPE: One declared tuple (token domain, intervals, boundaries, K, v, target, bridge, error model) is fixed for both compared cases before the mismatch test. No token, target, grain or implication may change within the test.
B:VIEW: D_v_PA is one physically anchored finite pointed/port-aware view with fixed state, timing, input/intervention, output and boundary conventions, plus any identified-set uncertainty. It need not be ontically complete; unavailable primitives are not silently supplied.
B:LANGUAGE: Expressions are finite well-typed trees built from admitted constants/physical inputs and Res, DoResp, Diff, Comp, Struct, Opt primitives. Each used primitive has a supplied typed interpretation on its admitted domain; optimizers require specified feasible sets, existence and tie rules. No global claim of minimality or computability of every primitive is made.
B:BAC: BAC(B_T,D_T) is the conjunction of seven requirements: source anchoring; output blindness/non-oracularity; bridge-rule fixation across instances; no post-hoc target refitting; covariance under admitted reparameterizations; possible failure/undefinedness; explicit imported commitments and residuals. It is a methodological predicate requiring evidence, not a theorem from the translator syntax.
B:TFR: For a named source-theory subclaim and exact version/domain, retain its distinctive target, strongest claimed scope, imported primitives and unrecovered residuals. Do not replace a phenomenal-necessity claim with a mere behavioral correlation and then report equivalence to the original claim.
B:EXPRESSIBLE: For every declared operational observable O_j and every admitted input instance in D_T, one fixed well-typed expression E_j(D_v_PA,B_T) denotes that observable, with its primitives defined and the SAME BAC-admissible B_T across instances. This is an assumption of membership in the expressible class, not a proof every theory belongs.
B:FV: Assign a specified subclaim independent categorical labels F in {F0 conflict,F1 compatible,F2 representable,F3 conditional derivation,F4 exact local reduction} and V in {V0 no validation,V1 toy proof of concept,V2 in-sample,V3 fixed held-out,V4 replicated/cross-system}. Neither coordinate entails the other; F is not a universal total ranking of whole theories.
B:RESIDUALS: For each named subclaim record relation in {REC reconstruction,EMB embedding,REI reinterpretation,CON conflict}, plus a separate residual set R_res and validation label V. An unrecovered commitment is not a derived edge or a fifth relation type.
B:EOD: EOD_UCT(c) means c concerns nonuniversal organization rather than universal basal existence, has reconstructible/embeddable operational content under BAC, separately labels its phenomenal/ontological interpretation, and explicitly retains unrecovered commitments. It does not mean ontological endorsement or complete reduction of the source theory.
B:TARGET_DOMAIN: Fix the rival's actual claimed domain D subset P_actual and same-target necessity claim forall P in D, E(P)=1 implies G(P)=1. Supply P0 in D with G(P0)=0. If the rival instead concerns a particular sensory content, replace E by that target; U1 alone no longer supplies its presence.
B:OVERLAP_WITNESS: There exists a specified lower token P that actually persists over I within/overlapping Q, while the rival's same-target exclusion claim assigns E(P)=0 solely because of overlap or nonmaximality. Persistence, domain inclusion and interpretation of E are independent joint premises.
B:IIT_BRIDGE: For the selected IIT mechanism subclaim, supply a current-state system chart, grounded intervention/repertoire laws, priors, intrinsic-difference metric, admissible partitions, max/min and tie conventions. All are fixed, BAC-admissible and source-faithful; exclusion/phenomenal identity are not generated by the shared arithmetic.
B:RPT_BRIDGE: For the selected RPT subclaim, supply a physically grounded causal graph plus sensory-content identification, episode timing and stabilization rules. Positive cycles alone supply neither specific visual phenomenality nor a universal experience gate.
B:GNWT_BRIDGE: For the selected GNWT subclaim, fix grounded content interventions, consumer channels, response distances, readout/timing thresholds and workspace architecture. The finite access measure represents this specified mechanism, not all phenomenal commitments.
B:HOT_BRIDGE: For the selected HOT subclaim, supply a tracking relation and independently justified representation/aboutness and higher-order target semantics, with timing and system boundary fixed. Statistical tracking alone does not discharge aboutness.
B:AST_BRIDGE: For the selected attention-schema subclaim, supply the schema/attention target, its installed control role and semantic grounding under one fixed chart. An observer-fitted predictor is not automatically the system's attention schema.
B:PP_AI_BRIDGE: For the selected predictive-processing/active-inference subclaim, fix agent/environment chart, generative p, variational q, policy class, preference and precision conventions, and independently supplied semantics. These imported choices remain bridge assumptions.
B:DIT_BRIDGE: For the selected dendritic-integration subclaim, provide the apical/basal/somatic/thalamic physical chart, input/output interventions, and relevant biological interpretation. A mixed-difference term is not by itself the full biological mechanism.
B:MTOC_BRIDGE: For the selected memory-theory subclaim, fix the retention relation and independently identified explicit-memory/assembly architecture, target content and temporal readout. A retained bit alone neither proves a conceptual memory experience nor refutes a correctly scoped necessity claim.
B:TTC_BRIDGE: For the selected temporospatial subclaim, fix scale/time coordinates and source-faithful nesting, alignment, expansion and globalization roles. Temporal multiscale statistics alone do not import every source ontological claim.
B:GRAPH: G=(V,E) is a finite directed graph; self-loops are explicitly included/excluded in E. A directed cycle has positive length. SCC means mutual reachability, with zero-length paths allowed for reachability but not used as cycles.
B:NEW_EDGE_RETURN: Choose vertices u,v with (u,v) not in E, and add exactly that edge. A prior return path means a directed v-to-u path in the OLD graph; for u=v the zero-length return path is admitted, so adding a self-loop qualifies.
B:NONLINEAR_WORKSPACE: Fix a differentiable synchronous state update x+=F(x;drive,parameters), a specified fixed point x*=F(x*), timing and readout. Linearized local stability uses D_xF(x*); a weighted adjacency matrix is interchangeable with it only under a separate equality premise. A spectral radius exactly one does not decide nonlinear stability.
B:MODEL19: Let sigma(z)=1/(1+exp(-z)), g in [0,1], q=sigma(10(g-1/2)), d(a,b)=sigma(-2+1.2a+1.2b+3q ab). Structural matrix is [[0,2],[3q,0]]. Synchronous workspace is x1+=sigma(5(-1/2+s+2x2)), x2+=sigma(5(-1/2+3q*x1)); declared readouts/iteration controls are those pinned in B sections 19.3-19.5, not an implicit bifurcation definition.
B:MODEL20: The pinned retention toy model uses m0=1, m_(t+1)=lambda*m_t; h_(t+1)=0.6h_t+0.4sigma(12(m_t-0.35)); w_(t+1)=0.7w_t+0.3sigma(10(h_t+1.2w_t-0.8)). Initial h,w, lambda grid, horizons and five consumer/readout conventions must be taken together from B section 20 before reproducing numerical results.
B:GRID19: This node records the numerical claims archived in pinned B sections 19.3-19.5 for the fixed model/grid/readouts. It is an evidence-record assertion, not an analytical theorem or a newly rerun computation; it does not establish a nonlinear bifurcation at structural rho=1.
B:GRID20: This node records pinned B section 20's finite retention-grid and edge-cut numerical outputs under its fixed initial conditions/readouts. It is not a full theory reduction, empirical consciousness datum, or a computation rerun by this audit.
C:FIXED_J: On one realized complete-type set S_K, fix evaluation contract M=(tasks,environments,resources,horizons,boundaries,ports,policy/adaptation class,score laws). J:S_K->product_mu Value_mu is well-defined and isomorphism-invariant. Random realized scores and estimates are not J. Any external dependence must be fixed or included in the domain.
C:SET_MAPS: Fix sets S,A,B and total set maps f:S->A,g:S->B. Fibers are F_f(s)={t in S:f(t)=f(s)}. Factor maps are required only on f(S); extending them to an arbitrary larger codomain may need additional nonemptiness/choice assumptions.
C:CONST_RANK: On open coordinate neighborhoods in smooth manifolds M^n,N^m, let f:M->N be C^1 (or smoother), with rank Df=r CONSTANT on a neighborhood of the point. Then use the constant-rank theorem locally. A rank number at a single critical point does not satisfy this premise.
C:PAIR_COUNTERMODEL: Take S={0,1}^2, complete type and experiential type both (x,y), J(x,y)=x, selected coordinate c(x,y)=y. Compare (0,1) to (1,0). This is an abstract C1-compatible type model, not an empirically validated richness measure.
C:SMOOTH_FITNESS: Fix a differentiable chart and maps J and F_I with w_I=F_I composed with J under the same ecology/resources. Directions v are tangent vectors at a named point; a finite constant-J path is an additional exact condition beyond DJ[v]=0.
C:SELECTION: Fix finite state/type set S, probability p, nonnegative weights W:S->R and mean barW=sum_s p_s W_s>0. The selection-only parent composition is psel_s=p_s W_s/barW. Traits are copied unchanged ONLY for the selection-only conclusion; descendant-trait changes are handled separately by DESCENDANT_ATTRIBUTION.
C:CLASS_WEIGHTS: W(s)=f(J(s)) on the same finite selection population. For any conditioned class j require p(J=j)>0 and f(j)>0, so that its post-selection conditional law exists.
C:DESCENDANT_ATTRIBUTION: Using the same reproductive weights and positive barW, Cprime_s is the finite attributed mean descendant trait of parent class s and post-reproduction mean is sum p_s W_s Cprime_s/barW. Cprime_s need not equal C(s). This is an extension of the reweighting setup, not simultaneous faithful copying plus arbitrary trait change.
C:MARKOV_SELECTION: S is finite, J:S->classes, K is a fixed row-stochastic transmission kernel and W(s)=f(J(s)) with f(j)>0 on every class. pplus_t=sum_s p_s f(J(s))K(s,t)/sum_s p_s f(J(s)). Closure is required for ALL initial distributions, with time/context fixed.
C:DECISION: Fix a finite joint law of (X,M,Y), common finite nonempty actions A and bounded payoff u(a,Y). Policies are unrestricted functions of the allowed observation, may ignore M, and information is supplied without changing states, deadlines, actions or costs. Conditional optimization concerns supported observation cells only.
C:CIRCUIT_SPEC: Independent IID fair bits X_t,N_t and independent E_t~Bernoulli(epsilon), 0<=epsilon<=1/2; fixed episode bits w,r; M_(t+1)=X_t XOR(w AND N_t) XOR E_t; output before update is Y_t=X_t for r=0 and M_t for r=1. Score against X_(t-1) after warm-up, with no other delayed channel. Across descendants w is inherited and r:0->1 with probability mu, 0<=mu<=1, with no reverse mutation in this comparison.
C:ENV_MEMORY: Target X_t is a stationary fair symmetric binary Markov chain with P(X_t=X_(t-1))=alpha in [0,1]; available memory M=X_(t-1) XOR E with independent E~Bernoulli(epsilon), epsilon in [0,1/2]. Task is binary prediction of X_t with unit correct-answer reward and no additional predictive channel.
C:MEMORY_COST: Two architecture frequencies are initially strictly between zero and one. Under the fixed environment and decision contract, W0=1+beta V_X>0, W1=1+beta V_XM-c>0 with beta>0 and declared cost c. Selection-only frequency change uses these supplied weights; equal storage size does not establish c=0.
C:ACTUAL_ENSEMBLE: Fix the same indexed ensemble of admitted actual tokens, complete signature K, type-to-coordinate map and partial order when comparing physical and experiential realized sets and Pareto frontiers. Comparing different times/ensembles requires a separate inclusion premise.
C:ACTUAL_INDEX_FAMILY: Fix one stimulus/comparison index set I and actual-token assignments in a common complete K. Equivalence relations on I use complete physical/experiential type equality; finite sensory coordinate equality is a separate possibly coarser relation.
C:RIVAL_DESCRIPTOR: On the same actual bearer/time domain and FULL-type target, a source-faithful rival posits assignment e_R=h(r). Supply actual P,Q with equal r but unequal complete k. This premise is not met by a rival that only predicts a selected phenomenal coordinate.
C:TRANSCRIPT: Fix two probability laws P,Q on the SAME scored transcript alphabet and common measurable score h taking values in [0,1]. Any target/label used in scoring is included in that joint transcript; output-only equality may omit it.
C:FINITE_LOSS: Fix a joint law of finite Y,Z,R and conditional predictors q_Z,q_ZR positive wherever the true conditional target has positive mass, with finite expected log loss. All entropies, KL and information use one declared log base. K_Z and K_ZR are their expected conditional KL excess risks.
C:NUISANCE_BOUNDS: For that finite joint law, define u=H(Astar|Z), d=I(Y;R|Astar,Z) for a specified descriptor Astar, and independently justify K_Z<=eta. Nonnegative K_ZR can be dropped only in the upper-bound direction; Astar's name 'sufficient' does not force u or d to vanish.
C:TV_PROFILES: Fix response laws P_i(s) on common finite alphabets and weights w_i>=0 with sum_i w_i=1. The profile distance is d(s,t)=sum_i w_i TV(P_i(s),P_i(t)); for infinite index families use a declared convergent sum/integral. These laws and weights are fixed across compared s,t.
C:PUBLIC_NULL_PREMISE: A fair binary target B is independent of the ENTIRE available public record H and observer's private random seed R jointly. The forced answer is a {0,1}-valued function of (H,R); selective abstention or a leaked target-dependent channel changes the protocol.
R126:PROJECTION: On the admitted complete-type domain let Phi:S_D->S_E be a bijection and p:S_D->Z any set map. Define the transported p_E=p composed with Phi inverse on S_E. The existence of this transported map is formal and supplies no physical selected-support mechanism.
R126:MODEL: Fix finite nonempty sufficient state set S, total deterministic operations F_a:S->S at named physical ports/time, onto summary p:S->p(S), and output r:S->Y. Quotient requirements range over EVERY s and declared a. Stable-refinement construction starts from ker(o), o(s)=(p(s),r(s)), or an explicitly declared finer initial partition P0.
R126:METRIC: Fix a metric d on the next-summary target Z and a predictor u_a:p(S)->Z using only the present summary and the named common action a. Worst-case error is sup_s d(u_a(p(s)),p(F_a(s))). No unrepresented hidden state or side input is allowed.
R127:TASK: Fix finite nonempty history H, query Q and answer Y sets and f:H x Q->Y on the whole declared Cartesian domain. A deterministic encoder c:H->C is chosen before and without the delayed query; decoder d:C x Q->Y must answer every admitted (h,q). Random/noisy protocols require their separately stated variants.
R127:RECOVERY: X has finite alphabet size m>=2 and an estimator Xhat computed from (C,B) plus randomness conditionally independent of X given (C,B), with actual error epsilon=P(Xhat!=X). Conditional data processing X -> (C,B) -> Xhat holds given B. H(X|B), not H(X), is the side-information-adjusted target entropy.
R127:EVENT_SUPPORT: In an independently physically grounded finite causal event graph, select a nonempty induced subhistory with connected inherited causal links over a declared interval, represent all materially relevant crossing ports and traceable occurrences/lineage, and identify coordinate renamings as descriptions of the same occurrences.
R127:RELATIONAL_SUPPORT: For admitted actual P, a retained sort/relation R and tuple a are physically constitutive in the complete common K. C1's h_P preserves and reflects R. If operations or a subalgebra are claimed, additionally require retained-domain closure or explicit boundary ports; arbitrary subset restriction need not be a subalgebra.
R127:PAIR_MODEL: X,N are independent fair bits; C=X XOR N and B=N. The decoding relation is X=C XOR B. Comparing C alone discards the side-information dependence; B is part of the complete decoding cut.
R127:LOCALIZATION_PAIR: Supply two admissible implementations with different internal/external register locations but identical complete exposed-interface law under EVERY allowed preparation/intervention/history policy. The observer has only that interface; no location-correlated timing, energy or side signal is admitted.
N128:COMMON_DETERMINISTIC: On the SAME sufficient S and total operations F_a, each p_i:S->Z_i obeys p_i F_a=Fbar_(i,a) p_i. Joint summary is p(s)=(p_1(s),p_2(s)) with codomain p(S), not an assumed full Cartesian product.
N128:MARKOV_WITNESS: S={0,1}^3 with state (X,Y,Z), fresh independent fair U per step, Xplus=U, Yplus=U XOR Z, Zplus=Z. Summaries p1=X,p2=Y; all initial states/distributions are admitted unless a declared invariant restriction is explicitly imposed.
N128:KERNEL: Fix finite nonempty S, same total row-stochastic kernels K_a for declared operations a and onto joint summary p=(p1,p2):S->p(S). Projected row at (s,a) is mu_(s,a)(z)=sum_(p(t)=z)K_a(s,t). Closure is constancy of this JOINT law on each present p-fiber.
N128:PRODUCT_LAW: For each s,a the next p1,p2 coordinates are conditionally independent under K_a(s,.), and each marginal law depends only on its respective present p_i(s). The factorization and marginal closure hold jointly for the same s,a/time model. Independence is sufficient, not necessary, for joint closure.
